name: @missing-elements/h5p-libraries
description: The H5P hub's runtime libraries for every content type it serves, as one .h5p bundle for <h5p-player>'s `libraries` attribute, so an export without its own libraries plays without asking the hub.

scripts.test: node -e "const { statSync } = require('node:fs'); if (statSync('libraries.h5p').size < 1e6) throw new Error('libraries.h5p is missing or empty')"
